title: centaurea debeauxii subsp. nemoralis
intro: Centaurea debeauxii subsp. nemoralis, commonly known as a type of knapweed, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea debeauxii subsp. nemoralis include its ability to act as an antiseptic, wound healer, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
